title: AI Sales Assistant for mid-market B2B companies
problem_statement: Mid-market B2B companies (200-1000 employees) lack accessible AI sales tools. Existing enterprise solutions are prohibitively expensive ($5k+/month), and industry-specific AI sales tools are virtually non-existent. Sales teams need productivity improvements without the complexity and cost of enterprise tools.
target_user: VP of Sales at mid-market B2B SaaS companies (200-1000 employees)
Sales Manager at mid-market B2B companies (200-1000 employees)
trigger_context: During quarterly planning cycles, sales leaders evaluate tools to improve team productivity. They seek solutions that are easier to deploy and more affordable than enterprise tools, but more sophisticated than basic CRM add-ons.
business_motivation: Multiple market signals indicate时机成熟: (1) Search volume for 'AI sales assistant' grew 150% YoY, demonstrating strong demand; (2) Enterprise solutions exist but target Fortune 500, leaving mid-market underserved; (3) AI technology has become commoditized and affordable, enabling new market entrants; (4) Industry verticalization in healthcare/education/legal sectors remains untapped.
constraints: Must avoid enterprise-level complexity and pricing
Deployment timeline: Must be deployable within 2 weeks
Pricing must be accessible to mid-market budget (estimated $500-2000/month range)
